status: Implementation specification; all tickets initially unstarted

priority_policy.P1: Required product differentiation and complete hackathon delivery
priority_policy.P2: Optional extension after all P0/P1 release gates

execution_policy: Choose dependency-ready work; phase is a grouping, dependencies determine actual order. Record code paths and validation evidence before marking done.

tickets.title: Create project and environment doctor
tickets.implementation_notes: Resolve compatible versions, lock dependencies, confirm Python/Node/OCR/Docker/provider availability, and establish the CLI module.

tickets.title: Implement safe participant import
tickets.implementation_notes: Validate ZIP/directory inputs, confine paths, hash sources, retain malformed-record and missing-file issues, and deduplicate manifests.

tickets.title: Isolate organizer evaluator
tickets.implementation_notes: Prepare evaluator outside app context, restrict app mounts, keep truth reveal off, and verify canary isolation without reading answers.

tickets.title: Implement domain schemas and persistence
tickets.implementation_notes: Define immutable documents, pairs, runs, observations, field results, reviews, jobs, drafts, challenges, and exports with constraints.

tickets.title: Implement persisted worker jobs
tickets.implementation_notes: Add atomic claiming, lease/heartbeat, cancellation, bounded retries, short DB transactions, stage checkpoints, and idempotency.

tickets.title: Build source evidence abstraction and TXT reader
tickets.implementation_notes: Return source blocks with immutable document IDs, line offsets, hashes, parser version, and multiline-label context.

tickets.title: Build native PDF extraction and preview
tickets.implementation_notes: Extract page/word/table context and render bounded previews; retain page dimensions and rotation for true source highlighting.

tickets.title: Build OCR recovery adapter
tickets.implementation_notes: Detect insufficient native text, OCR necessary pages, cache by bytes/settings, retain OCR geometry/method, and surface missing language/runtime support.

tickets.title: Build DOCX reader
tickets.implementation_notes: Extract paragraphs/tables/headers with order and locators; handle bilingual labels and disclose unsupported shapes.

tickets.title: Build XLSX reader
tickets.implementation_notes: Preserve sheets/cells/merged ranges/formulas/cached values, distinguish numeric formats, and avoid invented calculations.

tickets.title: Implement provider interfaces and modes
tickets.implementation_notes: Add local rules, configurable live AI, structured-output validation, usage tracking, bounded retry, and hash-checked recorded replay.

tickets.title: Implement evidence-backed email classification
tickets.implementation_notes: Classify current-request intent, preserve quoted thread context, record ambiguity, and route non-comparison categories correctly.

tickets.title: Implement content-based document roles and pairing
tickets.implementation_notes: Identify actual document type, treat filenames as hints, and require explicit selection for ambiguous version sets.

tickets.title: Implement independent field extraction
tickets.implementation_notes: Read each document independently, validate required keys/evidence, preserve candidates and absence, and support bounded targeted reread.

tickets.title: Implement party and port normalization
tickets.implementation_notes: Normalize harmless text only, keep meaningful identity and port context, and resolve same-document references with dependency tracking.

tickets.title: Implement container and weight normalization
tickets.implementation_notes: Use exact Decimal, explicit units, container quantity rules, missing-value detection, and ambiguity-aware formatting.

tickets.title: Implement comparison and case policy
tickets.implementation_notes: Compute three-way field results, preserve mixed outcomes, distinguish processing from verification, and require seven supported matches to clear.

tickets.title: Expose typed API and CLI
tickets.implementation_notes: Implement documented routes/commands, pagination, typed errors, version guards, run progress, and safe ID-based source access.

tickets.title: Build application shell and setup/import view
tickets.implementation_notes: Add real mode/readiness indicators, upload/run controls, accessible navigation, and no-data/failure states.

tickets.title: Build categorized inbox and exception queue
tickets.implementation_notes: Render category/outcome/unresolved counts and next action; keep count filters reconciled and classified-only separate from verified.

tickets.title: Build comparison and source-evidence workspace
tickets.implementation_notes: Show seven field rows, raw/normalized values, SI/BL passages, geometry/cell navigation, and simultaneous mismatch/unresolved findings.

tickets.title: Implement review transactions and dependency recomputation
tickets.implementation_notes: Version every review action, retain original machine output, resolve only source-supported readings, and recompute derived field dependencies.

tickets.title: Build targeted-review interface
tickets.implementation_notes: Display one actionable question with source context; distinguish uncertain reading, missing source, category, and pair selection.

tickets.title: Implement editable correction and information drafts
tickets.implementation_notes: Generate from validated findings, allow copy/download/edit, mark stale after result changes, and provide no outbound sending behavior.

tickets.title: Implement immutable revisions and outcome diffs
tickets.implementation_notes: Create new pairs for new source bytes, recompare all fields, preserve history, and detect resolved/persistent/new issues.

tickets.title: Build revision history and recovery UI
tickets.implementation_notes: Upload/select versions, show source and result diffs, reject stale state, and expose appropriate retry/replacement actions.

tickets.title: Implement strict submission and full-report exports
tickets.implementation_notes: Freeze exact result selection, validate IDs and cross-field conditions, preserve rich findings in a companion report, and block unrepresentable incomplete exports.

tickets.title: Connect aggregate organizer scoring
tickets.implementation_notes: Call configured evaluator, store actual response with export hash/version, and report known convention differences without changing operational results.

tickets.title: Create source-reviewed fixture manifest and split
tickets.implementation_notes: Review a diverse source subset without evaluator truth, retain label rationales/disputes, and group originals/duplicates/variants before tuning.

tickets.title: Implement fair baseline and evaluation runner
tickets.implementation_notes: Use comparable inputs/providers, freeze machine outcomes, compute quality/coverage metrics with explicit denominators, and record budget differences.

tickets.title: Implement source-mutating challenge engine
tickets.implementation_notes: Generate actual changed copies under preconditions, store source diff/expected effect/seed, isolate variants, and execute the real pipeline.

tickets.title: Build interactive challenge lab
tickets.implementation_notes: Show before/after source, selectable supported mutations, expected behavior, actual outcomes, and honest failures with evidence.

tickets.title: Implement technical metrics and evaluation view
tickets.implementation_notes: Show measured quality, coverage, failure/review breakdowns, usage/cost provenance, and separate live/replay/machine/assisted modes.

tickets.title: Instrument human-review effort and trial protocol
tickets.implementation_notes: Record active sessions/events with idle/visibility handling, provide balanced case assignments, and label savings pending when no people complete the trial.

tickets.title: Complete resilience and input-control checks
tickets.implementation_notes: Exercise timeouts, cancellation, stale reviews, archive limits, secret handling, worker restarts, and cache/version boundaries.

tickets.title: Run all user-flow browser tests and polish
tickets.implementation_notes: Verify eight flows on desktop/mobile with real backend state, fix evidence/layout/accessibility issues, and capture working-app screenshots.

tickets.title: Package persistent Docker and native startup
tickets.implementation_notes: Provide app and optional evaluator profiles, local origin and loopback defaults, persistence, dependency checks, and explicit safe reset instructions.

tickets.title: Run complete dataset and final evaluations
tickets.implementation_notes: Process all original emails, freeze machine output, validate export, collect actual organizer/baseline/challenge results, and document limitations.

tickets.title: Prepare business evidence and presentation
tickets.implementation_notes: Report observed results only, label pending human trial, explain value mechanism, document synthetic examples, and rehearse the four-minute demo.

tickets.title: Perform clean-machine release rehearsal
tickets.implementation_notes: Follow README from scratch, run no-key and configured-live paths as available, verify all required deliverables, and record exact commands and outcomes.

tickets.title: Extend structured-document challenge mutations
tickets.implementation_notes: After release gates, add actual DOCX/XLSX cell/text changes with provenance and exact mutation preconditions.

tickets.title: Add optional vision-assisted reread
tickets.implementation_notes: Only if provider support exists, compare targeted vision reread against OCR on held-out sources; preserve evidence gates and cost reporting.
